title: Find why background agents end without calling SubagentHandback, and fix the cause
why: A report that never arrives costs a resume and can stall a lane.
note: Owner feedback 12:57 CST Nov 11 (via the coordinator 13:00 CST), from a tile-windows coordinator session (10:45-12:55 CST): a test-author (77 tool uses, about 22 min) and a design-reviewer (79 tool uses, about 39 min) ended without calling SubagentHandback; the harness said "ended without delivering a report". Each sent a full report when asked by SendMessage. Ask: read those two transcripts' last turns (the tile-windows session transcript holds both task notifications; search "ended without delivering a report"), find why the call was skipped (long run, a final message with no call, or a context limit), and fix the cause in the agent definitions or a SubagentStop hook. Lane prose-agents started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
